headline: A big move for the Colts
what_happened: On their fourth and final try, D.Jones ran the ball forward to gain a first down, keeping the drive alive.
who: D.Jones ran while G.Karlaftis and C.Jones defended for KC.
why_it_matters: This was a good play for the Colts that increases their chances of winning by 8 percentage points. It keeps KC's lead at 7 points, but the Colts are now closer to the end zone.
